LanguageData.GDGC_AllowMugbGoblinCorpses.label: allow MUGB goblin/hobgoblin corpses
LanguageData.GDGC_AllowMugbGoblinCorpses.description: Allow corpses whose inner pawn is an MUGB goblin or hobgoblin xenotype.
